note: Holm v2 land gate changes on top of the v1 snapshot (tools/rebuild_holm_v2land.js applies them after lifting the leaves). Phase 4 (2026-09-26): the haven moved to Lanternfoot Cove below Lastlight, so its yard gate on the old south-east site is gone (Ferryman Tobin refuses to sail until Lastlight burns: HolmIslandCurriculum.board); the ore workings' east drift ladder and the keep's undercroft trapdoor stay shut until the bronze dagger is made.

services.message: The drift ladder is roped off. Foreman Durgin wants to see a bronze dagger first.
The trapdoor is bolted from below.
